description: This file defines the IoStream interface for managing bi-directional physical communication in a controller. It extends WriteStream and includes methods for setting input listeners, checking if the stream is closed, closing the stream, and purging buffers.

classes.name: IoStream
classes.description: An interface representing a physical, bi-directional communication stream for controller interactions. It extends WriteStream and provides methods to set data listeners, manage the connection state, and purge buffers.

methods.name: setInputListener
methods.description: Sets a DataListener that will be invoked upon input data reception; called from an implementation-dependent thread.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether the stream is closed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream, releasing any associated resources.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Purges pending input and output data from the stream buffers.
